name: EvaluatorSpec
description: EvaluatorSpec holds which agent is graded, how often, and within what spend.

fields.name: AgentId
fields.description: ID of the agent whose runs are graded.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.description:
Whether grading runs.

 A disabled evaluator keeps its settings and this month's counts; no
 new run is graded until it is enabled again.

fields.name: SampleRate
fields.description:
The share of completed runs graded, from just above 0 to 1.

 0.1 grades about one run in ten; 1 grades every run. Which runs are
 picked is fixed by each run's id, so a run's sampling never changes.

fields.name: MonthlyLimitUsd
fields.description:
The most this agent's grading may spend in one calendar month (UTC), in
 estimated US dollars of model cost.

 A grade sets aside its maximum cost before it starts; when that would
 pass the limit, the run is not graded and says so. The limit can be
 passed by at most one grade's overshoot.

fields.name: ModelName
fields.description:
The model the judge uses. Example: "claude-sonnet-4-6".

 Empty uses the platform's default model.
